class StackUnderflowError < StandardError; end

class Stack
  def initialize
    @store = []
  end

  def push(element)
    @store << element
  end

  def pop
    raise StackUnderflowError, "Stack is empty" if empty?
    @store.pop
  end

  def peek
    raise StackUnderflowError, "Stack is empty" if empty?
    @store.last
  end

  def empty?
    @store.empty?
  end
end
